dimensions.assessment: Affects geothermal energy developers, BLM field offices, and outside stakeholders involved in federal land leasing.
dimensions.evidence: use by the field offices of the Bureau of Land Management and geothermal operators.

dimensions.assessment: Standardizes procedures and guidelines for leasing and permitting to support efficient and environmentally responsible geothermal operations.
dimensions.evidence: support efficient and environmentally responsible geothermal leasing and permitting

dimensions.assessment: The source does not provide any federal spending, revenue, or economic impact figures.
Requires an update, renaming, and periodic 5-year review of an existing federal leasing guidance publication (the Gold Book).
dimensions.evidence: publish an updated version of the Gold Book incorporating any changes necessary

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent requirement for ongoing periodic revisions at least once every five years.
dimensions.evidence: at least once every five years, review the most recent version of the Gold Book

missing_information: Any budgetary or resource allocation costs for updating and publishing the Gold Book.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of the Interior to identify standard procedures for geothermal leasing and permitting on federal lands, incorporate them into an updated Gold Book, and review it every five years.
